fusions.name: Curled Spin
fusions.desc: Curls around the blade and spins, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each one back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scale Prising
fusions.desc: A short prying chop that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bladed Curl
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds. An escort of whirling edges fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Edged Scales
fusions.desc: 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
